business_problem: Industrial data is complex, spanning everything from the performance of individual equipment to energy outputs for entire regional systems.
solution_summary: Cognite built a Microsoft-based workflow around Cognite Data Fusion, Microsoft Sustainability Manager, and Azure because Industrial data is complex, spanning everything from the performance of individual equipment to energy outputs for entire regional systems. Source information is captured from frontline systems, documents, transactions, images, or conversations and then processed with cloud services that classify, summarize, model, or route the data for downstream use. The resulting records are stored in shared business or analytical systems and surfaced through apps, dashboards, or case workflows so staff can move from manual review to faster action while still keeping a governed human-in-the-loop process. solution_components.name: Cognite Data Fusion
solution_components.role: Unifies and contextualizes industrial asset data into a single model that is easier to analyze.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Sustainability Manager
solution_components.role: Maps operational data to sustainability measures and reporting workflows.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud foundation for hosting compute, storage, networking, and security services used by the solution.

data_flow: Source data is captured from frontline systems or content, processed by the Microsoft-based workflow, stored in a shared business or analytical layer, and then surfaced back to staff through apps, dashboards, or case-management experiences.
business_outcome: In a single, organized platform, Cognite Data Fusion® makes data consumable by providing a holistic, nuanced view of all existing data, enabling customers to take meaningful action to drive sustainability.
